campaign.title: Complete original-t=1 source: coefficients, masks and net power

resource_policy.budget: Three analytical reports, one bounded correction/review cycle, conductor synthesis. No numerical experiments.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete original-t=1 residual even-shift source, with P1 and P2 recombined, be bounded at L^2 X^epsilon; otherwise what exact coefficient norm or unmasked analytic estimate is missing after every mask and reconstruction cost?
frozen_target.reference_formula: C_even=sum_(0<r<R0, 2|r)(1-r/R0) sum_N c_(N+r,sigma)^rem conjugate(c_(N,sigma)^rem) e(sigma sqrt(X) r/(sqrt(N+r)+sqrt(N))), R0=ceil(L). Target Re C_even << L^2 X^epsilon; c and total zero-extended lambda are exactly K185.1--3. E_R<=2D+4Re C_even and scalar prefactor O(L).

No t>=2, complete M1/M2, bridge, target or exponent conclusion is implied by a t=1 result.
